title: Bribery sets up to a target
statement: Let $n>0$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and let $r\in\mathbb R$. Define sets of coordinates recursively by $J_0=\varnothing$. Given $J_t$, form the function obtained by setting every coordinate in $J_t$ to $1$ before evaluating $f$. If its uniform mean is less than $r$, add a coordinate of maximum influence for that modified function to obtain $J_{t+1}$; otherwise keep $J_{t+1}=J_t$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
